🗳️ THE RULES ARE BEING REVIEWED.

The Electoral Commission's chief executive has confirmed a review of the whole campaign spending framework — the £34m limit, party vs candidate spending, and reporting.

It lands weeks after two donors gave Reform UK £36m each.

I could write you the easy post about that timing. I'd rather write the honest one: ⚠️ ministers actually asked for this review back in July, before those cheques existed. That's on the record, and pretending otherwise would be dishonest.

So the argument isn't about WHY the review is happening. It's about what it concludes — and whether the ceiling quietly comes down at the exact moment a challenger party can finally afford to reach it.

✅ Transparency without limit.
✅ Limits without favouritism — parties, unions, companies, campaign groups, same fence, same rules.
